title: Fix xrandr BadMatch error with NVIDIA
summary: If xrandr --addmode fails with BadMatch, the NVIDIA driver may be restricting modes. Allow non-EDID modes in the Xorg configuration.
error_patterns: X Error of failed request: BadMatch

steps.explain: Edit /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/20-nvidia.conf. In the Device section, add the line: Option "ModeValidation" "AllowNonEdidModes".

rollback.explain: Remove the Option line from the configuration file and restart Xorg.

warnings: Allowing non-EDID modes can potentially set unsupported refresh rates or resolutions.
